hooks.name: Spec Types Drift Check
hooks.description: Compares design.md data types with types.ts when a design is saved

action.prompt: Compare the data types defined in the design file that was just saved with the types in packages/core/src/types.ts. List any drift (types in the design that don't exist in types.ts, or types that have different field names or types). Do not fix anything; only report the differences.
